stated: The Conservative Party will toughen sentencing for the worst offenders, making life imprisonment without parole mandatory for more heinous murderers and requiring rapists and serious sexual offenders to serve their full sentences in prison. They will also toughen sentences for knife crime, grooming gangs, and assaults against retail workers.

source.quote: We will toughen sentencing for the worst offenders. We have already ended Labour’s automatic halfway release for violent and serious sexual offenders. We will make life imprisonment without parole mandatory for more of the most heinous murderers and require rapists and other serious sexual offenders to spend the whole of their sentences behind bars.

bearing_set.reason: Mandatory life without parole for serious murderers, full-term imprisonment for rapists, and tougher sentences for knife crime and grooming gangs directly bear on the justice system, sentencing, and crime deterrence — all core O5 indicators.

Mandatory life without parole and mandatory full-term serving remove judicial discretion, expanding the state's compulsory detention power; this is a material bearing on the liberty-from-state-coercion indicator even where applied post-conviction.

Requiring full sentences (no parole) for rapists/sex offenders and more mandatory life terms materially increases the prison population in an already over-capacity estate (~88,000 in England and Wales), generating concrete, identifiable pressure on public spending and debt sustainability.

membership_note: Three genuine bearings: O5 (the intended safety improvement via incapacitation/deterrence), O10 (mandatory sentencing removes judicial discretion — a coercive-power expansion), and O12 (significant fiscal pressure from higher prison population). O9 and O15 were considered but the concrete mechanisms do not rise to a non-negligible independent verdict beyond what O5 captures.
